newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Union Carbide started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Union Carbide started.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities said analyst Donald Carson initiated coverage of Union Carbide Corp with a market performer rating, setting a 12-month price target of $50 on the stock.

-- J.P. Morgan said in a report it expects strong earnings growth over the next few years from Caribide's specialties and intermediates business will be offset by lower basic chemical and polymers profits resulting from a downturn in the petrochemical cycle.
-- The stock was up 1/8 at 45-3/4 in early trading.
